tools.name: search_guidelines
tools.description:
Look a rule up in the UMR guidelines (umr4nlp/umr-guidelines, guidelines.md).

keywords: terms to look for, e.g. "aspect", "modal strength", "have-rel-role-92", ":quant",
"reentrancy". Passages with more of the keywords come first, then those whose heading has
them, then those that mention them most.
max_results: how many passages to return (at most 10).

Returns {"sections": [{"heading": the passage's place in the guidelines ("Part 3. ... > Part
3-3-1. Aspect"), "text": the passage (a section, or a part of a long one)}], "found": how
many passages matched}.

tools.name: propbank_lookup
tools.description:
Look up a lemma and every alternate of it in PropBank (at most 20 per call).

language is "en" or "zh". Returns Markdown: per lemma, every roleset with its roles and all
its examples (the sentence, then each argument; traces such as *T*-1 are PropBank's own),
or "not in PropBank". Lemmas over the limit are not looked up: the last line names them
(call again with them). There is no PropBank for another language (Uzbek): nothing.

tools.name: search_annotations
tools.description:
Find how a case is annotated: gold UMR annotations of whole sentences.

language: "zh" (Chinese) or "en" (English).
keywords: words or pieces to look for, matched anywhere in a sentence or its annotation:
words of the text (e.g. "发生", "wanted to"), concepts ("have-org-role-91", "identity-91"),
roles (":ARG1-of", ":manner"), attribute values (":aspect state"). Sentences with more of the
keywords come first.
max_results: how many gold sentences to return (at most 10).

Returns {"gold": [{"doc", "sentence_number", "sentence", "annotation"}], where annotation is
the sentence's whole annotation (words, sentence-level graph, alignment, document-level
annotation); "found": how many gold sentences matched in all}.

messages.content:
## Input

Language: zh
Document: zh-0028, sentence 11 of 12

The previous sentences (at most five; number, tab, words):

6	它 有 三 个 接口 ， 分别 为 电源 、 HDMI 、 VGA 。

7	高清 的 HDMI 接口 成为 现在 市场 的 主流 ， 很 有 可能 HDMI 就 是 2012 的 一 个 趋势 ， 同时 还 保留 有 VGA 的 接口 ， 让 消费者 在 不同 需求 上 得到 满足 。

8	福韵 B560 系列 的 诠释 有 ： “ 福运 ” 、 “ 幸福 ” 、 和 拥有 贵族 的 “ 韵 ” 味 。

9	左右上角 的 两 条 龙 设计 的 毫 无 瑕疵 ， 机身 背后 写 有 一 个 大大 的 “ 福 ” 字 ， 并且 拥有 古代 龙纹 图案 ， 这些 都 有 浓郁 的 中国 元素 。

10	金黄色 的 B560 系列 看 起来 更 符合 龙年 的 韵味 ， 背部 的 福 字 也 更加 现眼 . 。

Their graphs:

# ::snt 6
# sentence level graph:
(s6h / have-91
    :ARG1 (s6p / thing
        :refer-person 3rd
        :refer-number singular)
    :ARG2 (s6x / 接口
        :quant 3
        :unit (s6x2 / 个)
        :ARG1-of (s6i / identity-91
            :ARG2 (s6a / and
                :op1 (s6x3 / 电源)
                :op2 (s6x4 / HDMI)
                :op3 (s6x5 / VGA))
            :mod (s6x6 / 分别-01)
            :aspect state))
    :aspect state)

I read the sentence as three linked clauses, joined by `and`:
1. HDMI is now the market's mainstream.
2. HDMI is very likely to be a 2012 trend.
3. VGA ports are kept too, so consumers' different needs are met.

The senses come from Chinese PropBank. Five choices were judgement calls rather than checked rules:
- **很有可能 ("very likely")**: I put it on the second clause as `:modal-strength partial-affirmative` with no node of its own. A gold search for 很有可能 found nothing, and the gold examples of 可能 were not the same construction.
- **Satisfying needs**: I treated 得到满足 ("get satisfied") as plain `满足-01`, with the consumers as the ones satisfied (`:ARG2`) and their needs as `:ARG1`.
- **HDMI and VGA**: I annotated both as named entities of type `product`. I did not check this type in the guidelines or the gold data.
- **成为 ("become")**: I gave it `:aspect state`, reading "has become the mainstream now" as a current state.
- **Dropped words**: 就, 很 and 一个 have no node of their own; 同时 ("at the same time") is kept as a `:temporal`.

# ::snt 7
# sentence level graph:
(s7a / and
    :op1 (s7c / 成为-01
        :ARG0 (s7j / 接口
            :mod (s7g / 高清)
            :mod (s7p / product
                :name (s7n / name :op1 "HDMI")))
        :ARG1 (s7z / 主流
            :poss (s7s / 市场))
        :temporal (s7x / 现在)
        :aspect state)
    :op2 (s7i / identity-91
        :ARG1 (s7p2 / product
            :name (s7n2 / name :op1 "HDMI"))
        :ARG2 (s7q / 趋势
            :quant 1
            :temporal (s7d / date-entity :year 2012))
        :aspect state
        :modal-strength partial-affirmative)
    :op3 (s7b / 保留-01
        :ARG1 (s7j2 / 接口
            :mod (s7p3 / product
                :name (s7n3 / name :op1 "VGA")))
        :mod (s7h / 还)
        :temporal (s7t / 同时)
        :aspect state
        :purpose (s7r / 让-02
            :ARG1 (s7k / 消费者)
            :ARG2 (s7m / 满足-01
                :ARG1 (s7x2 / 需求-01
                    :ARG0 s7k
                    :mod (s7y / 不同)
                    :aspect state)
                :ARG2 s7k
                :aspect performance)
            :aspect performance)))

我把句子分析为：「福韵 B560 系列的诠释」是一个事件名词，它通过「有」引出三项内容。

1. **「有」**：用 **有-07**，这个义项在 PropBank 里的意思是「ARG0 包含 ARG1 里的这些项」。这里的 ARG0 是「诠释」，ARG1 是后面列出的几项。体（aspect）标为 `state`。
2. **「诠释」**：用 **诠释-01**，它的 ARG1 是这个系列。因为它是事件名词，所以体标为 `process`。
3. **「福韵 B560 系列」**：处理成一个以 `系列` 为中心的节点，用 `:mod` 连到一个命名实体 `product`，名称为「福韵」「B560」。用 `product` 这个类型是我的判断，没有在标注数据里核对过。
4. **三项内容**：用 `and` 并列：「福运」「幸福」，以及 **拥有-01**（ARG1 为「韵味」，`:mod` 为「贵族」）。「拥有」在这里表达的是一种状态，所以体标为 `state`。

有一处不太确定：原文把「韵」加了引号，「韵」和「味」是两个分开的词。我还是把它们合成一个概念 `韵味`，所以这个节点可能无法和单个词对齐。

# ::snt 8
# sentence level graph:
(s8x / 有-07
    :ARG0 (s8x2 / 诠释-01
        :ARG1 (s8x3 / 系列
            :mod (s8p / product
                :name (s8n / name :op1 "福韵" :op2 "B560")))
        :aspect process)
    :ARG1 (s8a / and
        :op1 (s8x4 / 福运)
        :op2 (s8x5 / 幸福)
        :op3 (s8x6 / 拥有-01
            :ARG1 (s8x7 / 韵味
                :mod (s8x8 / 贵族))
            :aspect state))
    :aspect state)

# ::snt 9
# sentence level graph:
(s9a / and
    :op1 (s9s / 设计-01
        :ARG1 (s9l / 龙
            :quant 2
            :place (s9j / 左右上角))
        :manner (s9w / 无-01
            :ARG1 (s9x / 瑕疵)
            :degree (s9h / 毫)
            :aspect state)
        :aspect performance)
    :op2 (s9a2 / and
        :op1 (s9x2 / 写-01
            :ARG1 (s9z / 字
                :quant 1
                :mod (s9f / 福)
                :mod (s9d / 大大))
            :ARG2 (s9b / 背后
                :part-of (s9j2 / 机身))
            :aspect state)
        :op2 (s9y / 拥有-01
            :ARG0 s9j2
            :ARG1 (s9t / 图案
                :mod (s9l2 / 龙纹)
                :mod (s9g / 古代))
            :aspect state))
    :op3 (s9y2 / 有-01
        :ARG0 (s9z2 / 这些)
        :ARG1 (s9y3 / 元素
            :mod (s9c / country
                :wiki "China"
                :name (s9n / name :op1 "中国"))
            :mod (s9n2 / 浓郁))
        :mod (s9d2 / 都)
        :aspect state))

I worked from PropBank and the abridged guidelines. The gold examples I found were in a different annotation style, so I built this graph by the guidelines alone. These choices are the least certain:

- **Senses:** 设计-01, 写-01 and 拥有-01 come from PropBank. 无 was not looked up, so 无-01 for 毫无瑕疵 ("flawless") is a guess. Following the guidelines, it might need to be 无-00. For 有 in 这些都有……元素 I picked 有-01 (possession). 有-03 (existence) was the other option.
- **毫无瑕疵:** I treated it as a state 无-01 with 瑕疵 as its :ARG1 and 毫 as :degree, attached as the :manner of 设计-01. Two other options were 瑕疵 with :polarity -, or the whole phrase as one fixed concept.
- **写有:** I took 有 after 写 as a result marker, so it is not its own node. I gave 写-01 aspect state, since the character is there as an inscription. 背后 (part of 机身) is the :ARG2 location of 写-01.
- **Clause structure:** 并且 joins the "written on the back" clause and the "has ancient dragon patterns" clause in an inner `and`. The flawless-design clause and the "these all have Chinese elements" clause are joined in an outer `and` with no word behind it. I took 机身 as the owner (:ARG0) of 拥有-01. That subject is not stated in the sentence; I inferred it.
- **中国:** It is a named entity (country, wiki "China") used as a :mod of 元素.

I annotated sentence 10 as two clauses joined by `and`, both describing present states:

- **First clause:** I used `看-05` for 看起来 ("looks"). A gold example (zh-0001, sentence 25) puts the clause being judged in its `:ARG0`, so I did the same. 符合-01 ("be consistent with") takes the B560 series as `:ARG0` and the charm (韵味) of the Year of the Dragon (龙年) as `:ARG1`.
- **Second clause:** 现眼 ("conspicuous") is not in Chinese PropBank, so it becomes `现眼-00`. Its subject is the 福 character, placed on the back (背部).
- **更 / 更加 ("more"):** I wrote these as plain `:degree` modifiers. Gold sometimes uses `have-degree-91` for comparison instead, so this choice may differ from the expert annotation.
- **B560 系列:** I made 系列 ("series") the head. B560 is a `product` named entity attached with `:mod`, and 金黄色 ("golden") is another `:mod`. This structure is my own choice; I didn't check it against gold.
- **龙年:** a plain concept, not a `date-entity`.
- **也 ("also"):** `:mod`.

# ::snt 10
# sentence level graph:
(s10a / and
    :op1 (s10k / 看-05
        :ARG0 (s10f / 符合-01
            :ARG0 (s10x / 系列
                :mod (s10p / product
                    :name (s10n / name :op1 "B560"))
                :mod (s10j / 金黄色))
            :ARG1 (s10y / 韵味
                :possessor (s10l / 龙年))
            :degree (s10g / 更)
            :aspect state)
        :aspect state)
    :op2 (s10h / 现眼-00
        :ARG0 (s10z / 字
            :mod (s10f2 / 福)
            :place (s10b / 背部))
        :degree (s10g2 / 更加)
        :mod (s10e / 也)
        :aspect state))

This sentence:

11	中国人 的 习俗 ， 把 龙 当做 为 吉祥物 。

Its graph:

I treated the sentence as a habitual event, "(by) the custom of the Chinese people, the dragon is regarded as a mascot", built around `当做-01`.

# ::snt 11
# sentence level graph:
(s11x / 当做-01
    :ARG0 (s11p / 中国人
        :refer-number plural)
    :ARG1 (s11l / 龙)
    :ARG2 (s11j / 吉祥物)
    :manner (s11s / 习俗
        :possessor s11p)
    :aspect habitual)

- **Predicate and roles:** I checked `当做-01` in Chinese PropBank. The roles are ARG0 = who does the considering, ARG1 = what is considered, ARG2 = what it is considered as. So 中国人 is ARG0, 龙 (dragon) is ARG1 and 吉祥物 (mascot) is ARG2. 为 is read as part of 当做为 and gets no node of its own.
- **Aspect:** `habitual`, because a custom is something people do again and again.
- **习俗 (custom):** It is not in PropBank, so it is a plain noun. Its link to the main event is the least certain choice. I put it as `:manner`, with 中国人 as its `:possessor` written once and reused. Another reading would make it the head of an identity clause ("the custom of the Chinese people is to treat the dragon as a mascot").
- **中国人:** I kept it as one concept with plural number. I did not split it into `person` plus a country named "中国", mainly so it lines up with the single word in the sentence. I am not sure which form the gold data uses.

content.text:
# document level relations:
(d / document
    :temporal ((document-creation-time :overlap s11x))
    :modal ((root :modal author)
            (author :full-affirmative s11x)))

This sentence has only one event, `当做-01` (s11x, "regard the dragon as a mascot"), so it gets one temporal relation and one modal relation. I did not call any tools for these choices.

- **Temporal:** The custom holds now and is described as habitual, so I tied s11x to the document creation time with `:overlap`. `present-reference` would also have been possible for a general custom like this.
- **Modal:** The author states the custom plainly, so I gave s11x `full-affirmative`. Nothing else in the sentence acts as a conceiver.
- **Coreference:** I added none.
  - The dragon here (`龙`, s11l) is dragons in general. It is not the two particular dragons in sentence 9 (`s9l`) or the dragon pattern there (`s9l2`).
  - "Chinese people" (`中国人`, s11p) is a different kind of thing from the country China in sentence 9 (`s9c`).

  The gold annotation might still link the dragons.
